# FTI Consulting

> Global management advisory and business consulting firm specializing in crisis management, digital transformation, and expert dispute resolution across multiple industries.

FTI Consulting is a leading international consulting firm providing strategic advisory services to corporations, financial institutions, and government agencies. The firm combines deep industry expertise with capabilities in emerging technologies like AI and blockchain to address complex business challenges.

## Key Topics

- Business Consulting
- Crisis Management
- Management Advisory
- Digital Transformation
- Artificial Intelligence
- Blockchain
- Cybersecurity
- Antitrust
- Dispute Resolution
- Forensic Investigation
- Financial Services
- Merger Clearance
- Litigation Support
- Digital Asset Management
- Geopolitical Risk
